description:
Look at yourself: facts and numbers about you, the agent calling this tool. Only call it when you want to know; nothing is added to your prompt by itself. Two ways:
- overview, one line per part: {}
- some parts in detail: {"parts": ["history", "mailbox"]}  (or {"parts": ["all"]} for every part)
Parts: who (your name, definition, workspace, stack), state (running or paused, letters waiting in your queue, your last answer), tools (your tools and the ones you added or removed), llm (your brain settings), hooks (your hooks), history (how many messages, how big, the last few), mailbox (letters waiting in your mailbox), children (agents you started and how many you may have), resources (limits, memory and cpu time in use), time (now, how long you have been up).
Add "json": true for one JSON object instead of text. A part that cannot be read says "not available (why)"; the others still show.
Details: knowledge_read aos/me.json#/self_state.

parts.description: which parts to show in detail; leave it out for the one-line-per-part overview

json.description: true = one JSON object instead of text
